scope: Ordinary black-border Legends printings, eight materials, 36 calibration and 36 held-out cards. Original source plates replaced before calibration; no scan poses refitted.
method: Shared set/material frame and paper HSB, frozen frame poses, 36 calibration and 36 held-out cards. Minimum four per cohort/material. Median Oklab error <=5, median regression <=0.15, worst per-card regression <=2, clipping <=3%, dark-bin regression <=0.25, contrast-error regression <=0.5. Model-bound flags and texture residuals remain visible.
neutralPaper: Hue locks below 2.5% saturation. The previous 6% lock treated ABU's slightly pink paper as gray and preserved the wrong cast. Training Legends white printings consistently support a yellow-green paper hue; the same threshold is used for all materials.
search: Shared frame/paper HSB; hue locked for neutral paper. Fit only calibration colors. Cap transformed tile saturation/brightness at the 99.5th percentile, constrain frame shadow chroma/lightness and contrast error to no training regression. Retain unchanged frame color if no feasible improvement exists.
rasterMethod: Ordinary production renderer with set-hsb-v1. Color samples from the prepared, masked, composited plate; same frozen reference scans. Separate from whole-card accuracy.
remaining: Black, red and gold retain unmodified outer-frame color because the median-only fit worsened texture.
Land outer-frame correction is withheld: it turns gold pinlines lime. Add a measured pinline mask before adopting that hue/saturation fit; text-box color is adopted.
Color distances are Oklab diagnostics, not whole-card accuracy percentages.
Title, type, symbols, rules, artist and power/toughness still need calibration on the selected frames.
